faq.question: What is X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is an effervescent antioxidant nutraceutical tablet containing L-Glutathione (500 mg), Astaxanthin (6 mg), N-Acetyl L-Cysteine (50 mg), and Vitamin C (40 mg). It is designed to support the body's natural antioxidant defence and promote skin health through nutritional support.

faq.question: What are the ingredients in X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB contains: L-Glutathione 500 mg, Astaxanthin 6 mg, N-Acetyl L-Cysteine (NAC) 50 mg, and Vitamin C 40 mg per tablet.

faq.question: How does glutathione work?
faq.answer: Glutathione is a naturally occurring antioxidant in the body that helps protect cells from oxidative damage. It exists in reduced (GSH) and oxidized (GSSG) forms and participates in cellular redox balance. It works through enzymatic systems to neutralize harmful reactive species and support cellular health.

faq.question: Why is NAC included in the formula?
faq.answer: NAC (N-Acetyl L-Cysteine) provides cysteine, which is a key building block needed by the body to make its own glutathione. Cysteine availability is often the limiting factor in glutathione production, so NAC helps support the body's endogenous glutathione synthesis pathway.

faq.question: What is astaxanthin?
faq.answer: Astaxanthin is a powerful carotenoid antioxidant naturally found in microalgae. It has a unique molecular structure that helps protect cells from oxidative stress. In X-GLUTA TAB, it provides complementary antioxidant support alongside glutathione.

faq.question: Is X-GLUTA TAB a medicine or supplement?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is a nutraceutical (dietary supplement), not a medicine. However, professional guidance is recommended for optimal use. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

faq.question: Does X-GLUTA TAB whiten skin?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB provides antioxidant nutritional support that may contribute to healthier-looking, more radiant skin. However, it does not guarantee skin whitening, permanent skin color change, or fairness. Individual results vary based on many factors including genetics, sun exposure, and overall health. It should not be viewed as a skin bleaching agent.

faq.question: How is X-GLUTA TAB different from X-GLUTA IV?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is an oral effervescent tablet taken by mouth, while X-GLUTA IV is an injectable formulation administered intravenously by qualified healthcare professionals. The oral route passes through the digestive system, while IV administration delivers the ingredients directly into the bloodstream. The IV products are prescription-only and require medical supervision, while the TAB is a nutraceutical for general use with professional guidance recommended.

faq.question: How many tablets are in one pack?
faq.answer: One pack of X-GLUTA TAB contains 30 effervescent tablets, packaged as 2 tubes with 15 tablets each.

faq.question: How should I take X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: Dissolve 1 effervescent tablet in a glass of water and consume daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional. The effervescent format makes it easy and convenient to take.

faq.question: When should I take X-GLUTA TAB - morning or night?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB can be taken at any convenient time of day. Some people prefer morning for convenience, while others take it in the evening. Choose a time that works best for your routine and stick to it consistently. Consult your healthcare professional for personalized timing advice.

faq.question: Can everyone take X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: While X-GLUTA TAB is generally well-tolerated, you should consult a healthcare professional before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medications, or have any medical conditions. Do not use if you have a known allergy to any ingredient.

faq.question: What precautions should I follow?
faq.answer: Follow the label instructions, consult a healthcare professional if you have medical conditions or are taking medications, keep out of reach of children, and store in a cool, dry place. Discontinue use if you experience any adverse reactions.

faq.question: Is it safe during pregnancy?
faq.answer: If you are pregnant or nursing, please consult your healthcare professional before using X-GLUTA TAB or any dietary supplement.

faq.question: Will it work for everyone?
faq.answer: Individual results may vary. X-GLUTA TAB provides antioxidant nutritional support, but outcomes depend on many factors including baseline nutritional status, lifestyle, genetics, and overall health. It is not a guaranteed treatment and does not replace a healthy lifestyle or medical care.

faq.question: Can I take it with other supplements?
faq.answer: Please consult your healthcare professional before combining X-GLUTA TAB with other supplements or medications to ensure safety and avoid potential interactions.

faq.question: How long should I take X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: Duration of use depends on your individual needs and goals. Consult your healthcare professional for personalized guidance on appropriate duration. X-GLUTA TAB can be used long-term as part of nutritional support when appropriate.

faq.question: Do I need to take breaks between cycles?
faq.answer: Consult your healthcare professional about whether breaks are necessary for your specific situation. They can provide personalized guidance based on your individual needs and health status.

faq.question: Can children take X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is designed for adults. Consult a pediatrician or healthcare professional before giving any supplement to children.

faq.question: What if I miss a dose?
faq.answer: If you miss a dose, take it when you remember. If it's almost time for your next dose, skip the missed one and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double doses. Consistency is important for best results.

faq.question: Does it have any taste?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is formulated to be pleasant-tasting when dissolved in water. The effervescent format creates a fizzy drink that most people find easy and enjoyable to consume.

faq.question: How should I store X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: Store X-GLUTA TAB in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep the tube tightly closed. Keep out of reach of children.

faq.question: Can I take X-GLUTA TAB on an empty stomach?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB can typically be taken with or without food. If you experience any stomach discomfort, try taking it with food. Consult your healthcare professional for personalized advice.

faq.question: Is X-GLUTA TAB vegan/vegetarian?
faq.answer: For specific information about vegan/vegetarian status, please check the product label or contact Arykem directly for confirmation of all ingredients and manufacturing processes.

faq.question: Where can I buy X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is available through healthcare professionals, pharmacies, and authorized distributors. Contact Arykem Pharmaceuticals or check with your healthcare professional for availability in your area.

faq.question: How much does X-GLUTA TAB cost?
faq.answer: Pricing information may vary by location and distributor. Please contact Arykem Pharmaceuticals, your healthcare professional, or authorized retailers for current pricing information.

faq.question: Can I take more than one tablet per day?
faq.answer: The recommended dose is 1 tablet daily unless otherwise directed by your healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose without professional guidance. More is not necessarily better and may not be safe.

faq.question: What are the side effects of X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is generally well-tolerated when used as directed. Some individuals may experience mild digestive discomfort. Discontinue use and consult your healthcare professional if you experience any adverse reactions. Serious side effects are uncommon but should be reported immediately.

faq.question: Can diabetics take X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: Consult your healthcare professional before using X-GLUTA TAB if you have diabetes or any medical condition. They can assess whether it's appropriate for your specific situation and advise on monitoring.

faq.question: Does X-GLUTA TAB contain sugar?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is sugar-free. Check the product label for complete ingredient information including any sweeteners used.

faq.question: How many sessions will I need?

faq.question: What is the role of Vitamin C in the formula?
faq.answer: Vitamin C (500 mg) works synergistically with glutathione - it helps regenerate oxidized glutathione back to its active form, provides complementary antioxidant support, and helps stabilize the formulation. This combination enhances overall antioxidant effectiveness.

faq.question: Can diabetics receive X-GLUTA IV 600?
faq.answer: Diabetic patients can potentially receive X-GLUTA IV if their healthcare professional determines it's clinically appropriate. Diabetes is not an automatic contraindication, but requires medical evaluation and monitoring. Discuss your diabetes with your healthcare professional before treatment.

faq.question: Will insurance cover X-GLUTA IV?
faq.answer: Insurance coverage varies by policy, provider, indication, and region. X-GLUTA IV for aesthetic/wellness purposes is typically not covered. For medical indications, check with your insurance provider. Contact Arykem or your healthcare facility for payment information.

faq.question: Can I drive after IV session?
faq.answer: Most patients can drive after glutathione IV sessions, but individual reactions vary. Some people may feel tired or lightheaded. Discuss this with your healthcare professional and consider having someone accompany you for your first session to assess how you respond.

faq.question: Should I eat before IV session?
faq.answer: Your healthcare professional will provide specific pre-treatment instructions about eating. Some protocols recommend light meals before IV therapy, while others have different guidelines. Follow your healthcare professional's specific directions.

faq.question: What if I have allergies?
faq.answer: Inform your healthcare professional about ALL allergies (medications, foods, environmental) before receiving X-GLUTA IV. They will assess allergy risk and determine if treatment is safe. Allergic reactions are possible with any medication - professional monitoring is essential.

faq.question: Can I work out after IV session?
faq.answer: Consult your healthcare professional about physical activity after IV sessions. Generally, light activity is fine, but intense exercise immediately after may not be ideal. Follow your healthcare professional's specific recommendations for your situation.

faq.question: How is the IV administered?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA IV is administered through an intravenous line (IV catheter) inserted into a vein, typically in the arm. The solution is infused slowly over a period determined by your healthcare professional. The entire process is performed by qualified medical professionals in a clinical setting.

faq.question: What should I expect during the session?
faq.answer: During the IV session, you'll be seated or lying comfortably while the solution infuses. You should not feel pain during infusion (only brief discomfort during IV insertion). Healthcare staff will monitor you throughout. Many patients relax, read, or use their phones during the session. Report any unusual sensations immediately.

faq.question: Can I stop treatment anytime?
faq.answer: You have the right to discontinue treatment, but discuss this decision with your healthcare professional first. They can address any concerns and ensure proper discontinuation if needed. Stopping mid-treatment course may not provide desired results.

faq.question: Is there any smell or taste during IV?
faq.answer: Some patients report mild unusual taste sensations during IV infusions (sometimes described as metallic or vitamin-like). This is typically harmless. The solution itself is administered intravenously, not orally. Report any concerning symptoms to the healthcare professional administering your treatment.

faq.question: What is MarineX?
faq.answer: MarineX is a pure marine collagen builder powder containing marine collagen peptides, EPA & DHA omega-3s, hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, retinol, and biotin. It provides complete nutrition supporting skin elasticity, hydration, hair and nail strength, and joint comfort.

faq.question: What are the main ingredients in MarineX?
faq.answer: MarineX contains: Marine Collagen Peptides, EPA & DHA (60 mg), Hyaluronic Acid (25 mg), Vitamin C (38.40 mg), Retinol (30 mcg), and Biotin (30 mcg) per serving.

faq.question: What is marine collagen?
faq.answer: Marine collagen peptides are derived from fish sources. They are broken down into smaller peptide fragments that provide amino acid building blocks to support the body's natural collagen structure. Marine collagen is known for its bioavailability.

faq.question: How is marine collagen different from other collagens?
faq.answer: Marine collagen is sourced from fish and is primarily Type I collagen, which is the most abundant type in human skin. It may have good bioavailability. Other collagens come from bovine (cow) or porcine (pig) sources. Marine collagen is suitable for pescatarians.

faq.question: Why is vitamin C included?
faq.answer: Vitamin C is essential for collagen synthesis. It acts as a cofactor for enzymes that build collagen in the body. Including vitamin C with collagen peptides supports the body's natural collagen production process.

faq.question: What does hyaluronic acid do?
faq.answer: Hyaluronic acid is a naturally occurring substance that attracts and retains moisture in the skin. It helps maintain skin hydration, plumpness, and overall texture. In MarineX, it complements collagen for comprehensive skin support.

faq.question: What are EPA and DHA?
faq.answer: EPA and DHA are omega-3 fatty acids that support skin barrier function, hydration, and healthy cell membranes. They contribute to overall skin health and wellness.

faq.question: How should I take MarineX?
faq.answer: Add 1 scoop (10 g) of MarineX powder into a glass first, then add water. Mix thoroughly until evenly dispersed and consume. Recommended to take in the morning on an empty stomach before breakfast.

faq.question: How many servings are in one pack?
faq.answer: One 200 g pack of MarineX contains 20 servings (20 scoops). With the recommended schedule of 5 scoops per week with 2 days rest, one pack lasts approximately 1 month.

faq.question: Why take it on empty stomach?
faq.answer: Taking MarineX on an empty stomach before breakfast may support optimal absorption of the collagen peptides and other nutrients. This is a general recommendation, but consult your healthcare professional for personalized advice.

faq.question: Can I mix it with juice or coffee?
faq.answer: It's best to mix MarineX with plain water as recommended. Hot beverages may affect the collagen peptides. If you prefer, you can experiment with cold juice, but water is optimal. Avoid hot liquids.

faq.question: Will MarineX help with wrinkles?
faq.answer: MarineX provides collagen peptides and complementary nutrients that support skin structure and elasticity. It may contribute to overall skin health, but individual results vary. It is not a guaranteed wrinkle treatment. Results depend on many factors including age, genetics, sun protection, and lifestyle.

faq.question: How long before I see results?
faq.answer: Individual response time varies. Some people notice changes in skin hydration or nail strength within a few weeks, while others may take 2-3 months. Consistent use and patience are important. Results are not guaranteed and depend on individual factors.

faq.question: Can MarineX help with joint pain?
faq.answer: MarineX contains collagen peptides that support joint comfort and mobility. It may contribute to joint health as part of comprehensive care. It is not a medicine and does not treat or cure arthritis or joint diseases. Consult your healthcare professional for joint pain.

faq.question: Will it strengthen my hair and nails?
faq.answer: MarineX contains biotin and collagen peptides that support healthy hair and nails. Many users report improvements in nail strength and hair quality with consistent use. Individual results vary based on baseline health and nutritional status.

faq.question: Is MarineX suitable for vegetarians?
faq.answer: No, MarineX contains marine (fish-derived) collagen peptides, so it is not suitable for vegetarians or vegans. It may be suitable for pescatarians (those who eat fish).

faq.question: Can I take MarineX with X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: MarineX and X-GLUTA TAB address different aspects of wellness and may complement each other. However, please consult your healthcare professional before combining supplements to ensure safety and appropriateness for your individual needs.

faq.question: Does MarineX have a fishy taste or smell?
faq.answer: MarineX is formulated to minimize fishy taste and smell. Most users find it pleasant and easy to consume when mixed with water. If you're sensitive to taste, you can try mixing it with cold juice.

faq.question: Can pregnant women take MarineX?
faq.answer: If you are pregnant or nursing, please consult your healthcare professional before using MarineX or any supplement. They can assess safety and appropriateness for your specific situation.

faq.question: Are there any side effects?
faq.answer: MarineX is generally well-tolerated when used as directed. Some individuals may experience mild digestive changes initially. Allergic reactions are possible if you're allergic to fish or marine sources. Discontinue use and consult healthcare professional if any adverse reactions occur.

faq.question: Who should not take MarineX?
faq.answer: Do not use MarineX if you have a known allergy to fish or marine sources. Consult healthcare professional before use if you have medical conditions, are pregnant/nursing, or taking medications. Not suitable for vegetarians/vegans.

faq.question: How should I store MarineX?
faq.answer: Store MarineX in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep the container tightly closed. Keep out of reach of children.

faq.question: Can I take MarineX every day?
faq.answer: The recommended schedule is 5 scoops per week with 2 days rest (approximately 1 scoop per day for 5 days, then 2 days off). This pattern allows for rest periods. Consult your healthcare professional for personalized guidance.

faq.question: Where can I buy MarineX?
faq.answer: MarineX is available through healthcare professionals, pharmacies, and authorized Arykem distributors. Contact Arykem Pharmaceuticals for availability in your area.

faq.question: Can children take MarineX?
faq.answer: MarineX is formulated for adults. Consult a pediatrician or healthcare professional before giving any supplement to children.

faq.question: Can diabetics take MarineX?
faq.answer: Consult your healthcare professional before using MarineX if you have diabetes or any medical condition. They can assess whether it's appropriate and advise on monitoring.

faq.question: Does MarineX contain any allergens?
faq.answer: MarineX contains marine (fish) derived ingredients. If you have fish allergies, do not use this product. Check the label for complete allergen information and consult healthcare professional if you have concerns.

faq.question: What is the difference between MarineX and regular collagen supplements?
faq.answer: MarineX combines marine collagen peptides with synergistic ingredients: EPA & DHA omega-3s, hyaluronic acid, vitamin C (for collagen synthesis), retinol, and biotin. This comprehensive formulation addresses multiple pathways for skin, hair, nail, and joint health, rather than collagen alone.

faq.question: Can I take MarineX if I have thyroid problems?
faq.answer: Consult your healthcare professional before using MarineX if you have thyroid conditions or any medical condition. They can evaluate safety and interactions with your medications.

faq.question: Is MarineX gluten-free?
faq.answer: Check the product label for specific gluten-free certification. For detailed allergen information, contact Arykem Pharmaceuticals directly or consult your healthcare professional.

faq.question: What is LA3C?
faq.answer: LA3C is an advanced face serum formulated with 15% liposomal Vitamin C, along with Vitamin E, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, and Ferulic Acid. It's designed to support bright, hydrated, and healthy-looking skin through antioxidant skincare.

faq.question: What are the main ingredients?
faq.answer: LA3C contains: 15% Liposomal Vitamin C, 1% Alpha-Tocopherol (Vitamin E), 1% Niacinamide, 1% Hyaluronic Acid, and 0.5% Ferulic Acid.

faq.question: What is liposomal vitamin C?
faq.answer: Liposomal vitamin C uses liposomal technology where Vitamin C is encapsulated in protective lipid spheres. This helps improve stability and may support better delivery to the skin compared to regular vitamin C formulations.

faq.question: Why is vitamin C good for skin?
faq.answer: Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that helps neutralize free radicals, supports collagen synthesis (important for skin structure), and may help brighten skin tone. It's one of the most researched skincare ingredients for overall skin health.

faq.question: What does ferulic acid do?
faq.answer: Ferulic acid works synergistically with Vitamin C to enhance stability and antioxidant protection. It helps protect the vitamin C from degradation and provides additional antioxidant benefits to the skin.

faq.question: What is niacinamide?
faq.answer: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) helps reduce the appearance of uneven skin tone, supports skin barrier function, and improves overall skin texture. It's known for being well-tolerated and suitable for most skin types.

faq.question: How should I use LA3C?
faq.answer: Morning: Apply and massage gently, wait 20-30 minutes, then apply SPF. Evening: After cleansing, apply and gently massage. Use daily for best results. Always follow with sunscreen during the day.

faq.question: Can I use it in the morning and evening?
faq.answer: Yes, LA3C can be used both morning and evening. Morning application provides antioxidant protection throughout the day (remember SPF!). Evening application supports overnight skin repair. Both times are beneficial.

faq.question: Why do I need to wait before applying sunscreen?
faq.answer: Waiting 20-30 minutes after applying LA3C allows the serum to absorb properly into the skin before applying sunscreen. This ensures maximum effectiveness of both products without interference.

faq.question: Is sunscreen necessary with LA3C?
faq.answer: Yes, daily sunscreen is essential when using vitamin C serums or any brightening skincare. Vitamin C provides antioxidant protection, but sunscreen prevents new damage. Together they provide comprehensive skin protection.

faq.question: Can I use LA3C on sensitive skin?
faq.answer: LA3C is formulated to be suitable for most skin types including sensitive skin. However, individual tolerance varies. Perform a patch test first. If you have very sensitive skin, start with evening use only and gradually increase frequency.

faq.question: What is a patch test and how do I do it?
faq.answer: A patch test checks for allergic reactions. Apply a small amount of LA3C on your inner forearm or behind your ear. Wait 24 hours. If no redness, itching, or irritation occurs, it's likely safe to use on your face.

faq.question: Will LA3C help with dark spots?
faq.answer: LA3C contains ingredients that may help improve the appearance of uneven tone and dark spots over time with consistent use. Vitamin C and niacinamide are both studied for brightening effects. Results vary individually and take time (weeks to months). Not a guaranteed treatment.

faq.question: How long before I see results?
faq.answer: Individual response varies. Some users notice improved hydration and radiance within 2-4 weeks. Improvements in uneven tone or fine lines typically take 8-12 weeks of consistent use. Patience and consistency are key. Results are not guaranteed.

faq.question: Can LA3C remove acne scars?
faq.answer: LA3C may help improve the appearance of post-acne pigmentation over time with consistent use, but it cannot remove deep acne scars. For significant scarring, consult a dermatologist for appropriate treatment options.

faq.question: Will it help with wrinkles?
faq.answer: LA3C supports collagen synthesis through vitamin C, and provides antioxidants that may help with early signs of aging. It may improve the appearance of fine lines with consistent use. For deep wrinkles, professional treatments are typically needed.

faq.question: Can I use LA3C with retinol?
faq.answer: Vitamin C and retinol can be used together but require careful application. Use vitamin C in the morning and retinol at night, OR use them on alternate nights. Consult your dermatologist or healthcare professional for personalized guidance on combining active ingredients.

faq.question: Can I use LA3C with other serums?
faq.answer: LA3C can generally be incorporated into your existing routine. Apply from thinnest to thickest consistency. If using multiple active ingredients, consult a skincare professional to avoid irritation and ensure proper layering.

faq.question: What should I apply after LA3C?
faq.answer: After LA3C absorbs (wait 20-30 minutes), apply your moisturizer if needed, then sunscreen (morning routine). Evening: After LA3C, apply your night cream or moisturizer.

faq.question: Should I use LA3C on damp or dry skin?
faq.answer: Apply LA3C to clean, dry skin for best results. Pat your face dry after cleansing, then apply the serum. Applying to very wet skin may dilute the product.

faq.question: How much serum should I use per application?
faq.answer: A few drops (typically 3-4 drops) are sufficient for the entire face and neck. LA3C is concentrated, so a little goes a long way. Avoid using too much product.

faq.question: Can I use LA3C around my eyes?
faq.answer: Avoid direct contact with eyes. You can apply carefully around the orbital bone (under-eye area), but be cautious and avoid getting too close to the eye itself. If irritation occurs, discontinue use in that area.

faq.question: Will LA3C make my skin oily?
faq.answer: LA3C is a serum formulation designed to absorb into the skin without leaving a greasy residue. Most users find it lightweight. If you have very oily skin, you may not need additional moisturizer after LA3C.

faq.question: Can I use LA3C if I have acne?
faq.answer: LA3C can generally be used on acne-prone skin. Niacinamide may help with skin barrier function. However, if you have active severe acne, consult a dermatologist before adding new products. Avoid applying to open acne lesions.

faq.question: Does LA3C have a smell?
faq.answer: LA3C may have a mild characteristic scent from the active ingredients. It is not heavily fragranced. The scent should be subtle and should not be overpowering.

faq.question: How should I store LA3C?
faq.answer: Store LA3C in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat. Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use. Vitamin C products can degrade with light and air exposure, so proper storage is important.

faq.question: How long does one bottle last?
faq.answer: One 30 ml bottle typically lasts approximately 1-2 months with twice-daily use (morning and evening), depending on the amount used per application. Conservative use with proper application extends duration.

faq.question: What color should LA3C be?
faq.answer: LA3C should be clear to slightly yellowish. If the serum turns dark brown or orange, it may have oxidized and should not be used. Check expiry date and storage conditions.

faq.question: Can pregnant women use LA3C?
faq.answer: Topical vitamin C is generally considered safe during pregnancy, but consult your obstetrician or healthcare professional before using any skincare products during pregnancy or nursing.

faq.question: Can teenagers use LA3C?
faq.answer: LA3C can generally be used by teenagers with parental guidance, especially for concerns like uneven tone or dull skin. However, basic skincare (cleanse, moisturize, SPF) is often sufficient for young skin. Consult a dermatologist for teenagers with specific concerns.

faq.question: Is LA3C vegan and cruelty-free?
faq.answer: For specific information about vegan/cruelty-free status, please contact Arykem Pharmaceuticals directly for confirmation of ingredients and manufacturing practices.

faq.question: What is REPOB?
faq.answer: REPOB is a multi-strain pre & probiotic capsule containing Lactobacillus acidophilus, Lactobacillus rhamnosus, Bifidobacterium longum, Saccharomyces boulardii (totaling 1.54 billion CFU), and prebiotic FOS (100 mg) to support digestive microbiome balance.

faq.question: What are probiotics?
faq.answer: Probiotics are live beneficial bacteria and yeasts that support digestive health and microbiome balance. They are similar to the good bacteria naturally found in your gut and help maintain a healthy digestive system.

faq.question: What are prebiotics?
faq.answer: Prebiotics are types of fiber that feed the beneficial bacteria (probiotics) in your gut. FOS (Fructooligosaccharides) in REPOB acts as food for probiotics, helping them thrive and multiply in your digestive system.

faq.question: What is CFU?
faq.answer: CFU stands for Colony Forming Units, which measures the number of viable (living) bacteria in a probiotic. REPOB contains 1.54 billion CFU total from four different probiotic strains.

faq.question: Why multiple strains instead of just one?
faq.answer: Different probiotic strains have different benefits and work in different parts of the digestive system. A multi-strain formula like REPOB provides more comprehensive support for overall microbiome balance compared to single-strain products.

faq.question: How should I take REPOB?
faq.answer: Take REPOB as directed by your healthcare professional. Probiotics are typically taken once daily, often with food or as specified on the label. Follow the specific directions provided with your product.

faq.question: Should I take REPOB with food or empty stomach?
faq.answer: This depends on the specific product formulation. Some probiotics are better with food, others on empty stomach. Check your product label or consult your healthcare professional for the best timing for REPOB.

faq.question: Should I refrigerate REPOB?
faq.answer: Check the product label for specific storage instructions. Some probiotic formulations require refrigeration while others are shelf-stable. Follow the storage guidelines provided to maintain probiotic viability.

faq.question: Can REPOB help with bloating and gas?
faq.answer: REPOB supports digestive microbiome balance, which may help with occasional bloating and gas in some individuals. However, individual results vary. If you have persistent digestive symptoms, consult a healthcare professional for proper evaluation.

faq.question: Will REPOB help with constipation?
faq.answer: Probiotics support overall digestive function and may contribute to regularity in some individuals. However, REPOB is not a laxative or guaranteed constipation treatment. For chronic constipation, consult your healthcare professional.

faq.question: Can I take REPOB with antibiotics?
faq.answer: Antibiotics can kill both harmful and beneficial bacteria. Consult your healthcare professional about taking probiotics with antibiotics. They may recommend specific timing (e.g., taking them a few hours apart) to maximize benefit while on antibiotic therapy.

faq.question: How long should I take REPOB?
faq.answer: Duration depends on your individual needs and goals. Some people take probiotics continuously for ongoing support, while others use them for specific periods. Consult your healthcare professional for personalized guidance on duration.

faq.question: Can probiotics help with skin?
faq.answer: The gut-skin axis (relationship between digestive health and skin condition) is an area of ongoing research. Some studies suggest gut health may influence skin. REPOB supports microbiome balance, which is part of overall wellness. Individual responses vary.

faq.question: Can I take REPOB with other supplements?
faq.answer: REPOB can generally be taken with other supplements, but consult your healthcare professional to ensure no interactions and appropriate timing for your specific combination.

faq.question: Are there any side effects?
faq.answer: Probiotics are generally well-tolerated. Some people may experience mild digestive changes (gas, bloating) initially as the gut adjusts, which typically resolves within a few days. Discontinue use if adverse reactions occur and consult healthcare professional.

faq.question: Can pregnant women take REPOB?
faq.answer: Consult your healthcare professional before taking probiotics during pregnancy or nursing. They can assess safety and appropriateness for your specific situation.

faq.question: Can children take REPOB?
faq.answer: REPOB is formulated for adults. For children, consult a pediatrician who can recommend age-appropriate probiotic products and dosages.

faq.question: Do I need probiotics if I eat yogurt?
faq.answer: Fermented foods like yogurt contain beneficial bacteria, but probiotic supplements provide specific strains in measured amounts. REPOB offers targeted strains with prebiotic support. Both can be part of digestive health, but supplements provide consistency and specific benefits.

faq.question: How is REPOB different from other probiotics?
faq.answer: REPOB combines 4 different probiotic strains (including the beneficial yeast Saccharomyces boulardii) with prebiotic FOS in one formulation. This multi-strain approach with prebiotic support provides comprehensive microbiome balance.

faq.question: Can I take REPOB if I have IBS?
faq.answer: Some research suggests certain probiotics may help with IBS symptoms, but this varies by individual and strain. If you have IBS or digestive disorders, consult your healthcare professional before starting probiotics. They can guide appropriate use.

faq.question: What is KTOSEVEN?
faq.answer: KTOSEVEN is a bone health formulation combining Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin D3 (Calcitriol), Vitamin K2-7, and Zinc to support normal bone health and calcium metabolism.

faq.question: Why is calcium important?
faq.answer: Calcium is the primary mineral in bones and teeth. It's essential for bone structure, strength, and density. Adequate calcium intake throughout life supports bone health and may reduce risk of bone-related issues later.

faq.question: Why is vitamin D included?
faq.answer: Vitamin D (specifically D3/Calcitriol) is essential for calcium absorption from the digestive system. Without adequate vitamin D, your body cannot absorb calcium effectively, even if you consume enough. They work together for bone health.

faq.question: What is vitamin K2-7?
faq.answer: Vitamin K2-7 (MK-7 form) helps direct calcium to bones where it's needed and away from soft tissues where it shouldn't accumulate. It plays a role in calcium metabolism and bone health, working alongside vitamin D and calcium.

faq.question: Why is zinc in a bone health formula?
faq.answer: Zinc is an essential trace mineral involved in bone formation and metabolism. It plays a role in various enzymatic processes throughout the body, including those related to bone health.

faq.question: How should I take KTOSEVEN?
faq.answer: Take KTOSEVEN as directed by your healthcare professional or as specified on the label. Follow the recommended dosage and timing instructions provided.

faq.question: Should I take it with food?
faq.answer: Calcium supplements are often better absorbed when taken with food. Consult your healthcare professional or check the product label for specific instructions for KTOSEVEN.

faq.question: Can KTOSEVEN prevent osteoporosis?
faq.answer: KTOSEVEN supports bone health through calcium and vitamin D supplementation, but it is not a medicine and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent osteoporosis. Bone health requires comprehensive approach including nutrition, exercise, and medical care. Consult healthcare professional for osteoporosis concerns.

faq.question: Who should take KTOSEVEN?
faq.answer: KTOSEVEN may benefit adults seeking bone health support, those with low dietary calcium/vitamin D intake, postmenopausal women, older adults, or anyone advised by their healthcare professional to supplement calcium and vitamin D.

faq.question: Can young people take KTOSEVEN?
faq.answer: Bone health support is beneficial at all ages, but individual needs vary. Young adults building peak bone mass may benefit under professional guidance. Consult healthcare professional for age-appropriate bone health strategies.

faq.question: How long should I take KTOSEVEN?
faq.answer: Duration depends on your individual needs, dietary intake, vitamin D status, and healthcare professional's guidance. Some people take bone health supplements long-term as part of ongoing wellness, while others use them for specific periods.

faq.question: Can I get enough calcium from food?
faq.answer: Ideally, calcium should come from diet (dairy, leafy greens, fortified foods). However, many people don't meet daily calcium requirements through diet alone. KTOSEVEN can supplement dietary intake when needed. Consult healthcare professional to assess your needs.

faq.question: Can I take KTOSEVEN with other supplements?
faq.answer: Consult your healthcare professional before combining KTOSEVEN with other supplements, especially those containing calcium, vitamin D, or minerals, to avoid excessive intake and ensure proper absorption.

faq.question: Are there any side effects?
faq.answer: Calcium supplements may cause constipation or digestive discomfort in some people. Take with food and adequate water. If you experience kidney stones, hypercalcemia symptoms, or adverse reactions, discontinue use and consult healthcare professional.

faq.question: Can I take too much calcium?
faq.answer: Yes, excessive calcium intake can be harmful (hypercalcemia, kidney stones, interference with other mineral absorption). Do not exceed recommended doses. Consult healthcare professional about your total calcium intake from all sources (diet + supplements).

faq.question: Can pregnant women take KTOSEVEN?
faq.answer: Calcium and vitamin D are important during pregnancy, but pregnant women have specific needs. Consult your obstetrician or healthcare professional before taking KTOSEVEN or any supplement during pregnancy or nursing.

faq.question: Can people with kidney disease take KTOSEVEN?
faq.answer: If you have kidney disease, kidney stones, or kidney problems, consult your healthcare professional before taking calcium supplements. Calcium metabolism is affected by kidney function, requiring medical supervision.

faq.question: Should I take calcium and iron together?
faq.answer: Calcium can interfere with iron absorption. If you take iron supplements, take them at different times than calcium (several hours apart). Consult healthcare professional for optimal timing.

faq.question: Do I need sunlight if I take vitamin D supplements?
faq.answer: Sunlight helps your body produce vitamin D naturally. While KTOSEVEN provides vitamin D, sensible sun exposure (with sun protection) and dietary sources contribute to overall vitamin D status. Consult healthcare professional about your vitamin D needs.

faq.question: Can KTOSEVEN help with joint pain?
faq.answer: KTOSEVEN is formulated for bone health, not joint pain treatment. While bone and joint health are related, KTOSEVEN is not a pain reliever or arthritis medicine. Consult healthcare professional for joint pain concerns.

generalScience.simpleExplanation: Oxidative stress occurs when there are too many harmful molecules called 'free radicals' in the body and not enough antioxidants to neutralize them. This imbalance can damage cells.
generalScience.professionalExplanation: Oxidative stress represents an imbalance between the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and the biological system's ability to neutralize these reactive intermediates through antioxidant defences. ROS include superoxide anion, hydrogen peroxide, and hydroxyl radical. While ROS play physiological signaling roles, excessive accumulation can damage lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids, potentially contributing to various pathological processes.

sources.title: Free Radicals and Antioxidants in Normal Physiological Functions

generalScience.simpleExplanation: Antioxidants are substances that help protect the body's cells from damage caused by harmful molecules. They work like shields to keep cells healthy.
generalScience.professionalExplanation: Antioxidants are molecules capable of inhibiting the oxidation of other molecules by donating electrons to free radicals, thereby neutralizing their reactivity. The body's antioxidant system includes enzymatic defences (superoxide dismutase, catalase, glutathione peroxidase) and non-enzymatic defences (glutathione, vitamin C, vitamin E, carotenoids). These systems work synergistically to maintain cellular redox homeostasis.

sources.title: Antioxidants: In Depth
sources.organization: NIH - National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health

generalScience.simpleExplanation: Collagen is the most abundant protein in the body, providing structure to skin, bones, tendons, and ligaments. It's like the 'glue' that holds the body together.
generalScience.professionalExplanation: Collagen is a family of structural proteins representing approximately 30% of total body protein. Type I collagen predominates in skin, bone, and connective tissues. Collagen biosynthesis requires vitamin C as a cofactor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylase enzymes. With aging, collagen production naturally declines, contributing to skin changes and structural alterations.
